Where to Stay in Zanzibar — Areas & Beaches Guide

Each zone has a distinct character. Choose by your travel style: nightlife & diving (Nungwi/Kendwa), kitesurfing & adventure (Paje), culture & history (Stone Town), luxury & relaxation (Bwejuu/Michamvi), or authentic village life (Jambiani/Kizimkazi).

Quick Picks

Quick Picks by Travel Style

Match your vibe to the perfect zone — from party beaches to secluded hideaways.

Best Nightlife & Sunsets

Nungwi & Kendwa — Full-moon parties, beach bars, sunset cruises, Mnemba diving

Best for Kitesurfing & Adventure

Paje & Jambiani — World-class kitesurfing, shallow lagoon, Kuza Cave, Jozani Forest access

Best for Culture & History

Stone Town — UNESCO heritage, carved doors, spice markets, Freddie Mercury, slave trade history

Best Luxury & Seclusion

Bwejuu, Dongwe, Michamvi, Pongwe — Boutique resorts, private beaches, The Rock Restaurant

Best for Dolphin Watching & Village Life

Kizimkazi — Ethical dolphin tours, 12th-century mosque, Menai Bay access, quiet beaches
